title: Chilaquiles Rojos
description: Tortilla chips simmered briefly in a red chile-tomato sauce until just softened, topped with fried eggs, crema, cheese and onion.

image.alt: A skillet of tortilla chips in red sauce with fried eggs, cheese and onion

ingredients.prep: half roughly chopped, half thinly sliced for serving

steps.text: Blend the tomatoes with their juice, the chopped onion, garlic, chili powder, broth and salt until smooth.

Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in the skillet over medium heat. Pour in the sauce carefully (it will spatter) and simmer until slightly thickened and darker, {time 8-10 min}. Transfer to a bowl and wipe out the skillet.
Heat the rest of the oil in the skillet and fry the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks still runny, {time 3-4 min}. Move them to a plate.
Return the sauce to the skillet and bring to a simmer. Add the chips and fold gently until coated and just starting to soften, {time 1-2 min}. Serve right away, before they turn soggy.
Top with the fried eggs, dollops of sour cream, the cheese, sliced onion and cilantro.

notes: Thick, restaurant-style chips hold up best; thin chips go soft almost immediately.
The sauce can be made up to 3 days ahead and kept in the fridge.
